rules.false_equivalence: HTTP 200 or a non-error Agent response equals business pass
rules.required_evidence: Every required hard oracle must pass against tool, provider, repository, or browser evidence.

rules.false_equivalence: The model says it wrote a bill equals a Xero write receipt
rules.required_evidence: One provider write, one Xero InvoiceID, DRAFT status, and exact same-ID readback.

rules.false_equivalence: DRAFT equals posted, approved, authorised, paid, reconciled, or filed
rules.required_evidence: Use only the literal Xero status; DRAFT must be reported as awaiting human review.

rules.false_equivalence: An open emergency write gate proves the request has accounting authority
rules.required_evidence: The execute receipt must bind the exact Case/version, workspace, Agent, installation, Tenant, target session and active Standing Delegation revision before one write attempt.

rules.false_equivalence: Same-request idempotent replay proves cross-request business duplicate prevention
rules.required_evidence: A different request_id with the same source, supplier, and supplier document is rejected or resolves to the same provider record.

rules.false_equivalence: Several Agents using one OAuth token prove multi-user or multi-tenant isolation
rules.required_evidence: Independent users, independent bindings, deny-by-default cross-access, and independent revoke/reconnect evidence.

rules.false_equivalence: An in-memory or local synthetic fixture pass proves the live Xero deployment
rules.required_evidence: A separately labelled remote MCP or final browser run with live tool receipts.

rules.false_equivalence: source_sha256 proves the original Work file
rules.required_evidence: A Host-signed receipt over the immutable file identity, version, digest, user, workspace, and action.

rules.false_equivalence: BLOCKED, NOT_RUN, UNSUPPORTED, or skipped equals PASS
rules.required_evidence: These statuses remain distinct and count as zero passes.

rules.false_equivalence: A prepared Case or technically valid operation equals a completed ledger write
rules.required_evidence: Prepare reports NOT_WRITTEN. Execute loads the immutable stored Case, revalidates Standing Delegation, and success requires Provider receipt plus exact same-ID readback for every eligible operation.

rules.false_equivalence: The first page equals complete history
rules.required_evidence: Follow hasNextPage until false, preserve truncation flags, and report any bounded or incomplete association list.

rules.false_equivalence: Missing currency, association, allocation, opening balance, or record equals zero or none
rules.required_evidence: Report the field as unknown or unavailable and state the evidence needed to resolve it.

rules.false_equivalence: An expected-red failure counts as a passing test
rules.required_evidence: Keep actual_status=FAIL and record expected_red_observed=true until the underlying hard oracle passes.

rules.false_equivalence: A shared logical-Agent run proves independent Agent configuration or credential ownership
rules.required_evidence: Record Agent IDs, MCP configuration fingerprints, and OAuth binding fingerprints separately.
